text: Gazprom dobycha Orenburg (OOO Gazprom dobycha Orenburg) is a wholly owned (100%) subsidiary of Gazprom.
short: Gazprom owns 100% of Gazprom dobycha Orenburg.

source.name: Oren.Ru (regional news outlet): The head of Orenburg's gas producers announced his resignation
source.quote: ООО «Газпром добыча Оренбург» — 100-процентное дочернее общество ОАО «Газпром».
source.note: Company-profile paragraph in the article. «ОАО «Газпром»» was Gazprom's corporate form before its 2015 re-registration as a public joint-stock company (ПАО); a later source below uses ПАО.

additionalSources.name: History Depositarium (Museum of Victory project): Faces of Victory — OOO Gazprom dobycha Orenburg
additionalSources.quote: ООО «Газпром добыча Оренбург» – 100-процентное дочернее общество ПАО «Газпром».
additionalSources.note: Company profile page of the Victory Museum's History Depositarium project. The page itself carries no publication date; 2026 is the year shown in the site footer. Gazprom's own site (gazprom.ru) states the same 100%-subsidiary fact in its July 2026 subsidiary news (article584912), but gazprom.ru timed out from the research environment and could not be opened to quote.
